name: reports
title: Reports
summary: Business reporting with stated meanings: metric definitions with a named owner and versions, a report catalogue grouped by business area, report queries with an explicit date basis, currency and time zone, the admin and seller dashboards, and authorized export jobs. All figures come from read models fed by other modules' events, never from their tables.
owns: Metric definitions with owner, version history and change suggestions (gross vs net sales, marketplace sales vs marketplace fee income, date basis, currency, time zone, tax treatment)
Report catalogue in six groups: Commerce, Company trading, Marketplace finance, Products and discovery, Service and sellers, Customers, marketing and ads
Report queries with filters (date range, date basis placement/payment/shipment/completion, sold by, seller, category, currency, time zone) and saved views
Admin dashboard figures (gross sales, orders, marketplace fee income, refunds, Official Store vs marketplace split)
Seller dashboard (work for today, dispatch deadlines, sales, payouts, performance, announcements) and seller reports scoped to the caller's seller
Authorized exports for every module: async jobs with permission-filtered columns, audit and expiring download links
Read models (facts per order item, refund, return, payout, service event, discovery signal, campaign and ad charge) built from events, with rebuild
notOwns: Source records: orders, payments, finance, inventory, shipping, returns, support, promotions, advertising own them
Ad display, click and dismissal tracking and attribution: advertising (reports reads its daily totals)
Campaign results pages: promotions and advertising have their own detail views; reports holds the cross-campaign summaries

publicApi.name: registerDataset
publicApi.desc: Owner modules register the columns of their datasets at boot. Only keys in the export dataset registry (ExportDatasetKey, setting exportDatasets) are accepted. Rows are read page by page through the owner's own publicApi function exportRows(dataset, filters, principal, cursor); reports runs the job, filters columns by permission and stores the file.

publicApi.name: requestExport
publicApi.signature: (input: { dataset: string, filters: json, format: 'csv' | 'xlsx' | 'jsonl', principal: identity.Principal, sellerId?: uuid }) => ExportJob
publicApi.desc: Used by other modules' export endpoints; same rules as POST /exports, including the dataset's own permission for the principal (jsonl only for audit.admin.entries). Their status endpoints read the job back with getExport.

publicApi.name: recordSignal
publicApi.signature: (signal: { kind: 'product_view' | 'search_no_result' | 'cart_add', productId?: uuid, offerId?: uuid, query?: string, sessionKey?: string, at: datetime }) => void
publicApi.desc: Discovery signals that are not events (anonymous counts only)

publicApi.name: metric
publicApi.desc: Published definition text for tooltips in other modules' screens

publicApi.name: officialMargin
publicApi.signature: (range: DateRange) => { sales: Money, costedSales: Money, cost: Money, marginPct: number | null }
publicApi.desc: Official Store gross margin for a range of market days, by order placement date (the Official Store margin report's figures): sales, the sales with a known buying cost, that cost and the margin in percent of costed sales (null without costed sales). Promotions shows it before and during a campaign range.

publicApi.name: storeReturnRate
publicApi.signature: (range: DateRange) => { returnedUnits: int, soldUnits: int, returnRatePct: number | null }
publicApi.desc: Store-wide return rate for a range of market days: units asked to return in the range ÷ units sold (placed) in the range, in percent (null when nothing sold). The same figure as the Returns by reason report.

publicApi.name: getAdminDashboard
publicApi.desc: Admin dashboard figures with definitions (same as GET /api/admin/reports/dashboard)

publicApi.name: getSellerDashboard
publicApi.desc: The seller's own dashboard figures and work tiles (same as GET /api/seller/reports/dashboard); sellerId always comes from the session

publicApi.name: getExport
publicApi.desc: One export job for its requester (NOT_FOUND for anyone else); while ready each call signs a fresh download link and records it. The module status endpoints GET …/exports/{id} proxy it.

publicApi.name: listExports
publicApi.signature: (filter: { dataset: string, state?: string, allRequesters?: bool }, principal: identity.Principal, cursor?: string) => { items: ExportJob[], nextCursor?: string }
publicApi.desc: Export jobs for one dataset, newest first: the principal's own, or every requester's when allRequesters is set (the calling module checks its own permission first). Used by the audit export list.

RANGE_TOO_LARGE.meaning: The range is longer than maxRangeDays

EXPORT_TOO_LARGE.meaning: The export matched more than maxExportRows rows. Known only while the job runs (no request answers it): the job fails with this message in ExportJob.error (details.maxRows, details.matchedRows = rows read before stopping); narrow the filters and export again.

OWNER_REQUIRED.meaning: A metric needs a named owner before it is published

METRIC_IN_USE.meaning: A published report still uses this metric

DATASET_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: The dataset is not in the export registry or its owner module is disabled

RECIPIENT_NOT_PERMITTED.meaning: Scheduled report recipients must be active staff holding the report's permission. details.staffIds.

REBUILD_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: This read model is kept from events only and cannot be rebuilt until an event log exists

notes: Report definitions follow plan ch. 19: every result states range, date basis (placement, payment, shipment or completion), currency, time zone and tax treatment; gross sales are distinguished from sales after cancellations and refunds; marketplace sales are never shown as marketplace fee income (fee income lives in Marketplace finance).
Read models only: reports never queries another module's schema. Events feed fact tables; figures without events are pulled daily through public APIs. Each read model can be rebuilt.

Figures without events are pulled daily: fee income per seller and day from finance.marketplaceIncomeByDay(range), and displays, clicks, dismissals and attributed purchases per campaign and day from advertising.dailyPerformance(range). When finance or advertising is off, those figures are listed in `unavailable`.

Some figures are read from their module when the report runs, not kept in a read model: the Official Store trading costs of Purchasing cost, Discounts and shipping expense and Returns cost from finance.companyCostsByDay(range) (by booking day), Complaint patterns and the case first replies from support.caseStatsByDay(range, sellerId), and seller replies to customer messages from messaging.replyStatsByDay(range, sellerId). When the module is off or fails, its figures are listed in `unavailable`.
Sellers only ever see their own results: seller endpoints take the seller from the session and the report definitions with audience seller.

Exports for every module run here (registerDataset / requestExport) so permission filtering, audit and link expiry are uniform ('authorized exports', plan ch. 18). Module export endpoints (catalog, offers, inventory, returns, orders, customers, sellers, workqueues, audit, trust) return reports.ExportJob; their status endpoints proxy getExport.

Export dataset registry: every Export button exports one ExportDatasetKey. Staff: reports.report_result (reports, reports.<group>.view (the report group permission)); catalog.admin.products (catalog, catalog.products.export); offers.admin.offers (offers, offers.offers.view); inventory.admin.stock (inventory, inventory.stock.view); purchasing.admin.receiving (purchasing, purchasing.orders.view); shipping.admin.exceptions (shipping, shipping.exceptions.view); returns.admin.requests (returns, returns.requests.view); returns.admin.inspections (returns, returns.inspections.record); support.admin.cases (support, support.cases.view); finance.admin.ledger (finance, finance.ledger.view); finance.admin.payout_run (finance, finance.payouts.prepare); finance.admin.checks (finance, finance.reconciliation.work); finance.admin.overview (finance, finance.ledger.view); advertising.admin.campaigns (advertising, advertising.campaigns.view); promotions.admin.campaigns (promotions, promotions.results.view); workqueues.admin.items (workqueues, workqueues.items.export); orders.admin.orders (orders, orders.orders.export); customers.admin.accounts (customers, customers.accounts.export); sellers.admin.accounts (sellers, sellers.accounts.export); audit.admin.entries (audit, audit.entries.export); trust.admin.reports (trust, trust.reports.export). Seller: offers.seller.offers (offers, offers.offers.export); inventory.seller.stock (inventory, inventory.stock.export); returns.seller.requests (returns, returns.requests.export); orders.seller.orders (orders, orders.fulfillment.export); finance.seller.ledger (finance, finance.balances.view).

Export rows: reports never reads another module's tables. Each owner module exposes publicApi exportRows(dataset: string, filters: json, principal: identity.Principal, cursor?: string) => { rows: json[], nextCursor?: string } for its datasets, applies its own row scoping (a seller only gets its own rows) and masking (e.g. orders contact details), and registers the columns with registerDataset. reports.report_result is produced by reports itself.

Module export endpoints (orders, customers, sellers, workqueues, catalog, offers, inventory, returns, audit, trust) are shortcuts that call requestExport with their dataset key; POST /exports accepts the same keys directly, so the Export buttons on admin/returns, admin/finance, admin/payouts, admin/cases, admin/promotions, ops/inventory, ops/receiving, ops/dispatch, ops/return-inspection and ops/finance-checks need no endpoint of their own.

Phase 2: scheduled report emails and seller report exports (POST /api/seller/reports/exports on seller/reports; plan ch. 20 'better seller reports'). Seller list exports are phase 1: orders.seller.orders, offers.seller.offers, inventory.seller.stock, returns.seller.requests and finance.seller.ledger run through requestExport from their owner modules, because the seller Orders, Products, Inventory, Returns and Finance ledger lists are phase-1 seller operations (plan ch. 11 and 20) and their screens have Export. Launch measures are a small set (settings.launchMetrics); more are added when each has an owner.
dependsOn is empty as in the architecture doc; everything else is optional and degrades to `unavailable`.

Scheduled reports go to staff only (decision D2): recipients are staff ids with the report's permission, checked when the schedule is saved and at every run; each recipient gets an export job in their own name, so the download link works for them and nobody else. Formats are CSV and XLSX; PDF was removed.

Metric and group owners are nullable (decision D10): seeded metrics and groups start without a person (shown with the expected role) and are named with PUT /metrics/{key}/owner and PUT /groups/{key}/owner; a metric still needs an owner to be published.
Refunds over several sellers are split per seller (decision D5); see fact_refunds.

Fulfilled by Marketly (fulfillment-service, phase 4): fact_order_items.fulfilled_by from orders.order.placed groups; Marketly's dispatches, overdue packages and delivery issues (shipping.shipment.exception) for those groups go to fact_marketly_fulfillment_daily, never to the seller's fact_service_daily row, so seller on-time dispatch, overdue and delivery-issue figures only count what the seller shipped; service fees per seller and day go to fact_marketplace_finance_daily.service_fees_minor from fulfillment-service.fee.charged and fee.reversed. Metric definitions (seeded): 'Service fees' (marketplace finance group, Σ service_fees_minor) and 'Fulfilled by Marketly on-time dispatch' (service group, Σ dispatched_on_time ÷ Σ dispatched × 100 over fact_marketly_fulfillment_daily). The seller dashboard shows a service-fees line. Export datasets fulfillment-service.seller.fees, fulfillment-service.seller.stock, fulfillment-service.admin.stock_by_owner and fulfillment-service.admin.fees are registered and served by fulfillment-service.
